name: BIFROST Files & Storage
description: User-directed local, cloud, and self-hosted storage account metadata, scoped folder inspection, and opt-in profile configuration.

platforms.macOS: local terminal source implemented and synthetic tests

runtime.sourceIntegration: Existing BIFROST Headless, authenticated loopback read-only API only

delegation.BIFROSTcore: capability resolution, permissions, verified receipts and provider routing
delegation.PENELOPE: optional independently authorized user file custody/organization
delegation.JANITOR: optional independently authorized storage inspection and cleanup
delegation.DropboxLite: independent prior Dropbox verified-hash engine; no automatic integration

security.default: no account authorization or file transfer
security.pathScope: explicit selected folder; direct children only; symbolic links and protected paths blocked
security.auth: provider or Rclone owns credentials; user sign-in required
security.crossProvider: no transfer until provider-specific verified adapters
security.externalService: no automatic authentication, installation, or server connection

actions.name: storage.profiles.add.apply
actions.consequence: writes explicitly confirmed user profile metadata, not cloud files

actions.name: storage.icloud.list
actions.consequence: one-level Apple-managed iCloud folder metadata only; no hydration

actions.name: storage.profile.preview
actions.consequence: One saved-profile directory metadata only; remote read explicitly selected

actions.name: storage.headless.catalog.source
actions.consequence: Authenticated local metadata only; no token or account scan

actions.name: storage.headless.accounts.metadata.source
actions.consequence: Authenticated metadata of user-configured remote names/types only

actions.name: storage.headless.profile.preview.source
actions.consequence: Authenticated exact-saved-profile read-only metadata preview; no cloud sync
